hooks.text: The first photograph of Earth from space was taken by a weapon.
The first photo of Earth from space did not come from a satellite.
Humanity saw Earth from outer space eleven years before Sputnik.

title: The Weapon That Photographed Earth from Space
description: In October 1946, scientists launched a captured V-2 rocket into space. It returned humanity's first photograph of Earth's curved horizon.
